remarks: Location, Location, Location! Perfectly located in the Hindley Blue ribbon school district, this beautiful Colonial is warm and welcoming from the moment you step through the front door. The formal living room featuring a wood-burning fireplace, is complimented by a formal dining room and cozy office. Steps away, at the heart of the home, the spacious kitchen seamlessly flows into the family room, boasting a wet bar and another wood-burning fireplace. Adjacent to the kitchen is a bonus room ideal for a playroom or additional home office. A convenient half-bath completes the main level. Upstairs, are the home's four bedrooms and three full bathrooms. The primary suite impresses with two large walk-in closets and a luxurious bathroom featuring a jetted tub, steam shower, and radiant heat floors. Not to be missed is the finished lower level, complete with a full bathroom and home gym.  Outside, a stunning stone patio with a built-in grill sets the stage for perfect entertaining. Located on one of Darien's most desirable streets, and close to schools, trains and beaches this home is a must see!
